name: Tefaro
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Glottolog refs are wordlists/surveys only (Jones 1987; Bouwman & Holster 1985 survey wordlist); no phonology or grammar exists.

sources.citation: SIL Language & Culture Archives record 69265 'Tefaro Wordlist Jones' (1987-02-23; 'Includes sociolinguistic questionnaire and grammar notes'; Draft, posted as is)
sources.note: Catalogue record only; PDF on sil.org is Cloudflare-403 but the Wayback Machine holds a 2024-09-10 capture, which is the file saved above.

sources.citation: Held sister-language sources checked for Tefaro/Demba mentions: Voorhoeve 1975 Languages of Irian Jaya checklist (PL B-31,../awyi1241/) and Clouse 1997 Lakes Plain reconstruction (PL A-85,../iauu1242/)
sources.note: Neither mentions Tefaro, Demba or Nadoefoeai (grep); Voorhoeve lists only Tarunggare, Baropasi, Bauri under East Geelvink Bay.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page and md.ini for Tefaro (tefa1238)
sources.note: 8 references, 0 descriptive (wordlists, overviews, Ethnologue, Sugono 2008 map book); altnames Demba, Nadoefoeai, 'Tefaro (Demba)'.

sources.citation: sil.org site-search result pages (Cenderawasih; Demba; 'linguistic situation' Irian Jaya; earlier-session Tefaro / 'Wordlist Jones' pages../wori1246/) and archive.org full-text + metadata search for 'Tefaro'
sources.note: Establish that SIL archives only the two Tefaro wordlists online, and that archive.org full text has only Wikipedia dumps plus Italian 'Pesaro' scanned false hits for 'Tefaro'.

sources.citation: Jones, Larry B. 1987. Tefaro/Demba [UNCEN-SIL survey wordlist form 3/85, Tefaro village, Kec. Waropen Bawah, Kab. Yapen-Waropen, 23 Feb 1987]. 5 pp., 200 entries + sociolinguistic questionnaire + grammar notes. SIL Language & Culture Archives entry 69265 (Glottolog ref 555918, hh:w:Jones:Tefaro).
sources.note: Nothing. All five pages viewed as images: handwritten phonetic transcription of 200 items (glottal stops, a few length/nasal marks) with no stress marks on any word; the printed box 'Notes on phonetics and transcription' is left blank; 'Existing literature about the language' blank; grammar notes cover only word order, adjective/numeral order, tense adverbs and person. Silent on stress.
Stub citing Ethnologue 22 only; 'too poorly attested' to be sure of family membership; nothing on phonology.
Summary only: endangered, East Geelvink Bay family, used by all adults but not all young people; no linguistic description.

sources.citation: Jones, Larry B. 1987. The linguistic situation in the East Cenderawasih Bay, Irian Jaya: A preliminary survey. Unpublished SIL Papua survey report, 10 pp.
